title: The Secret of Tremendous Corporation
reason: Production approval was withdrawn after the pinned Steam-tag source exposed third-party asset exceptions that are not covered by the current blanket open-license record. The in-game credits distinguish original assets from third-party material and identify music and sound effects under separate licenses, including noncommercial and Sampling+ terms. Current author metadata saying assets are CC-BY-SA-4.0 is not sufficient by itself to establish authority to relicense those third-party works. Abandonware must complete and preserve an asset-level rights ledger, resolve every noncommercial/unclear exception, and then repeat production review before hosting the Version 6 game data.
